Same night the Machala-Santa Rosa road was closed by an overflowing river. In the demo farm's catchment. Alert episode 2026-02-05..2026-03-15 (39 d).

notes: COUNTS ONLY, NOT SKILL (SPEC method 14): show hits, misses and false alarms; POD/FAR/CSI are in the file only because the contract requires them. Alert = any demo lot at Severe (W >= 0.90, D-029). Counting unit for hits and false alarms: the alert episode (consecutive UTC days with any lot at Severe); a flood with no episode inside its window (1 day before to 1 day after the local dates) is a miss. (a) FARM'S OWN CATCHMENT (Rio Buenavista), 2026-01-01..2026-11-13: 1 hit, 0 misses, 4 false alarms; episodes (start, length): 01-26 (5 d), 02-05 (39 d), 06-10 (2 d), 10-03 (12 d), 10-20 (20 d); days with any lot at Severe: 78 of 317. Replay window 2026-01-20..2026-03-05: 1 hit, 0 misses, 1 false alarms. False alarm = no flood in this press list, not proof of no flood. (b) REGIONAL CONTEXT, NOT VERIFICATION: 3 of 3 documented El Oro floods on other rivers (Rio Chico/Caluguro 11-12 Oct; Chaguana 19 and 26 Oct 2026) fell inside a Severe episode of the demo lots. October 2026 IMERG Early rain is far above 2015-2025 and its independence from the V07C/GPROF v08 change (March 2026) is unverified. LEAD TIME: the 23 Feb flood rain (UTC 23 Feb) can reach W at the earliest at 2026-02-24T04:00:00Z (end of the UTC day + 4 h IMERG Early latency); El Universo reported the overflow at 09:54 local on 23 Feb. The demo lots were already at Severe from earlier storms (episode 2026-02-05..2026-03-15): the engine gave no flood-specific lead time. Escalations in the replay: 1: warning before 01-20, severe 02-07; 2: warning before 01-20, severe 01-26, severe 02-05; 3: watch before 01-20, warning 01-24; 4: watch before 01-20, warning 01-21; 5: watch before 01-20, warning 01-22; 6: watch before 01-20, warning 01-25; 7: watch before 01-20, warning 01-21, severe 02-07, severe 02-24; 8: watch before 01-20, warning 01-23. KNOWN LIMITS: W uses percentiles against the whole-year history, so wet-season days stay high for weeks (seasonal percentiles are a post-hackathon class A item, T-048). Travel time: Kirpich used far outside its calibration range (basins of 1-112 acres; this one is 254 km2); lag 0 d is in-sample (same event). Day definitions are mixed (IMERG UTC days, POWER local-solar days). A missing W (POWER gap) holds the level. SENSITIVITY (T-024b): each weight +/-0.10, rest renormalised, 10 variants, replay re-run. Baseline lots at Severe (UTC days): 1: 02-07..03-05; 2: 01-26..01-30, 02-05..03-05; 7: 02-07..02-20, 02-24..03-05. Strict result (same lots, same days): NOT STABLE in 10 of 10 variants: upstream +0.10: gains lot 4; days shift for lot 1, 2 | upstream -0.10: days shift for lot 2, 7 | saturation +0.10: gains lot 4; days shift for lot 7 | saturation -0.10: days shift for lot 1, 2 | terrain +0.10: loses lot 7; days shift for lot 2 | terrain -0.10: gains lot 4, 5, 8 | local +0.10: days shift for lot 2 | local -0.10: days shift for lot 1, 2 | balance +0.10: gains lot 4 | balance -0.10: days shift for lot 2. Flood days 02-21..02-24: baseline lots at Severe 1, 2, 7; same set in 5 of 10 variants; Severe in every variant: lots 1, 2; in at least one: lots 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8.
